scope: original-only fixture references, no Wordling integration evidence

macro_cases.title: Record and execute a named macro
macro_cases.observation: Record ABC, stop, execute in same buffer; recording and execution are distinct actions.

macro_cases.title: Repeat a macro using Repeat Value
macro_cases.observation: Record ABC, switch to blank Doc2, Repeat Value3 then execute.

macro_cases.title: Macro stops on a default failed search
macro_cases.observation: Default DISPLAY OFF failed search stops before SHOULDNOT; original saved result includes manually typed READY after termination. BEFORE alone is the pre-interactive screen result.

macro_cases.title: Macro IF ELSE and GO LABEL control flow
macro_cases.observation: IF1 chooses TRUE, IF0 chooses FALSE through ELSE; GO/LABEL skips SKIP and produces TAIL.

macro_cases.title: Handle a macro failed search with ON NOT FOUND
macro_cases.observation: ON NOT FOUND/GO MISS catches failed search; SHOULDNOT skipped.

macro_cases.title: ON ERROR handles a missing nested macro
macro_cases.observation: ON ERROR/GO ERR catches absent nested macro; SHOULDNOT skipped.

macro_cases.title: Nested child error handler is local and parent handler resumes
macro_cases.observation: Child handles its missing-file error locally and RETURNs; parent R resumes, then parent original handler catches another missing-file error. Child does not inherit parent handler.

macro_cases.title: Unhandled child macro error returns to parent handler
macro_cases.observation: Unhandled child missing-file error defaults to RETURN ERROR; parent catches it. CHILDBAD and PARENTBAD continuations do not execute.

macro_cases.title: FOR loops include endpoints with positive and negative steps
macro_cases.observation: FOR1..3 step1 followed by FOR3..1 step-1; inclusive endpoints and DONE marker observed.

macro_cases.title: WHILE skips a false condition and terminates after variable updates
macro_cases.observation: WHILE0 skips BAD; N initialized0 and incremented until3; second WHILE emits0,1,2.

macro_cases.title: FOR EACH preserves explicit order and repeated values
macro_cases.observation: FOR EACH numeric list15,10,15,5 retains order and duplicate15.

macro_cases.title: NEXT skips the rest of a FOR iteration
macro_cases.observation: FOR1..3 NEXT at2 skips remaining body only for that iteration;3 and DONE survive.

macro_cases.title: BREAK inside IF exits the enclosing FOR
macro_cases.observation: FOR1..5 BREAK inside IF at3 exits enclosing FOR before emitting3, rather than merely leaving IF.

macro_cases.title: BREAK exits only the current nested FOR level
macro_cases.observation: Outer I1..2, inner J1..3 BREAK atJ2 exits inner only; both outer R continuations survive.

macro_cases.title: Mixed FOR and WHILE loops reset and advance inner state
macro_cases.observation: Outer FOR resets J0; inner WHILE J<2 emits pair and increments; reset/order/termination observed.

macro_cases.title: FOR EACH preserves raw and quoted string values
macro_cases.observation: FOR EACH quoted list red/blue sky/red then unquoted list; quoted section retains literal quotes, spaces and duplicates. No general quote-unescaping rule inferred.

macro_cases.title: FOR EACH evaluates arithmetic and variable-containing expressions
macro_cases.observation: ASSIGN B4; FOR EACH1+2, VARIABLE B+4, VARIABLE B+1 evaluates3,8,5; no claim about deferred timing or arbitrary expression coercion.

macro_cases.title: NEXT advances only the current nested loop
macro_cases.observation: I1..2 and J1..3; NEXT atJ2 advances inner only; J3 and outer R survive.

macro_cases.title: Top-level macro file BREAK is ignored
macro_cases.observation: No enclosing IF/loop: A BREAK BDONE produces ABDONE. BREAK ignored in this top-level macro fixture.

macro_cases.title: File-level BREAK in the nested macro fixture is ignored
macro_cases.observation: Parent P nests child C BREAK CHILDBAD then emits RDONE. Child remainder runs; file-level BREAK ignored in this nested macro fixture.
